svg.title: Kasir POS: how work flows
svg.desc: 1. Open the shift (Cashier): Picks who is on the till and counts the opening cash by denomination. 2. Take the order (Cashier): Chooses staff, customer and dine in or takeaway, then adds items with options and kitchen notes. 3. Cook (Kitchen): The order appears on the kitchen screen and items are ticked from received to cooking to ready. 4. Order from the table (Guest): Scans the table QR code, orders from a phone and the ticket joins the same kitchen flow. 5. Take payment (Cashier): Splits the bill across cash and the shop's own QRIS, and marks the QRIS part as received by hand. 6. Record purchases (Manager): Logs a market trip with a receipt photo, and the app flags items bought above the usual price. 7. Close and report (Owner): Closes the shift, reads the daily report and the list of things that need attention. 8. Ask the agent (Owner): The AI agent reads the numbers over MCP, drafts a change, and the owner approves it with a PIN.
svg.text: From the first step to the last, and who does what.
